readme.run: Analyze a dermoscopic lesion image (DullRazor, Shades of Gray, Otsu, ABCD)
notes: Input is a JPEG or PNG dermoscopic photograph.
Pass --pixels-per-mm N (or --mm-per-pixel N) for calibrated millimetre morphometry.
Pass --differential-structures 1..5 to also compute Stolz Total Dermoscopy Score (TDS).
No network connection is required and no external model weights are downloaded.
Experimental automated morphometry only — not a clinical diagnosis.
